description: “Melbourne House” by Susan Warner is a novel written in the mid-19th century. The story centers around a young girl named Daisy Randolph, who is portrayed as thoughtful and earnest, grappling with profound questions about faith, morality, and social values in a world that often seems indifferent to the concerns of the poor.
